description: This Java class 'AcknowledgementAggregator' manages the collection and processing of acknowledgements for a specific entity and correlation ID, including handling timeouts, expected acknowledgements, and generating aggregated acknowledgement results.

classes.name: AcknowledgementAggregator
classes.description: A class to aggregate required and received acknowledgements for a single request, managing timeouts, expected acknowledgements, and producing combined acknowledgement results.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of AcknowledgementAggregator with either EntityIdWithType or NamespacedEntityIdWithType.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID associated with this aggregator.

methods.name: addAcknowledgementRequest
methods.description: Adds an acknowledgement request to the aggregator, initializing its timeout acknowledgement.

methods.name: addReceivedAcknowledgment
methods.description: Processes a received acknowledgement, updating internal state if it was expected.

methods.name: receivedAllRequestedAcknowledgements
methods.description: Checks if all expected acknowledgements have been received.

methods.name: isSuccessful
methods.description: Checks if all received acknowledgements are successful.

methods.name: getAggregatedAcknowledgements
methods.description: Builds and returns the aggregated acknowledgements, including validation of the correlation ID.
